cancMetaDescrizione: Request deletion of your Kidville account from the web, without signing in to the app.
cancIntro: From this page you can request the deletion of your Kidville account, even without signing in to the app or reinstalling it.
cancInviato: If the address is linked to a Kidville account, you will receive an email with a link to confirm the request. Please also check your spam folder.
cancErrore: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.
cancConfermaIntro: Press the button to confirm the deletion request for your Kidville account. The request will be handled by the school office, which will anonymise your personal data.
cancConfermaOk: Request registered. The school office will handle it and irreversibly anonymise your personal data. Tax documents are kept as required by law.
cancConfermaErrore: We could not register the request. The link may have expired or already been used: go back to the deletion page and request a new one.
cancConfermaLinkNonValido: Invalid or incomplete link. Go back to the deletion page and request a new link.
moduloAccessoCorpo: This form is only available to registered users. Log in to fill it out.
wizardAdultoInfo: At least one adult is required. If you are already the parent of an enrolled child, use the same tax code: the new child will be automatically linked to your profile.
wizardErroreInvio: An error occurred while submitting. Check your details and try again.
wizardInviataCorpo: Your enrollment request has been received. The office will review it and contact you with your login credentials.
wizardRiepilogoConteggio: You are enrolling <n>{bambini}</n> {bambini, plural, one {child} other {children}} with <n>{adulti}</n> {adulti, plural, one {adult} other {adults}} as reference contacts.
wizardRiepilogoNota: Press Submit request to send your details to the office. You will receive confirmation and login credentials after review.
wizardSedeSub: Choose the site where you want to enroll your child
